dog.description_text:
Meet Roscoe Roo! This handsome gentleman is proof that good looks and a beautiful soul make the perfect combination. After coming to NYC Second Chance Rescue from a difficult situation, Roscoe Roo is ready for the fresh start he deserves. Sweet, docile, and gentle, he has that calm, lovable charm that makes you want to wrap your arms around him and tell him he's finally home. Roscoe Roo isn't asking for much, just a safe place to land and a family who will love him for the rest of his days. Could this gentle gentleman be the missing piece of your family? Give Roscoe Roo the forever home he's been waiting for!

Every bio is just a snapshot of the animal. For more information about Roscoe Roo and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home, please reach out to our Adoptions Team.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
